01 / THE AGENCY

A fresh agency.
A considered approach.

You run the business.
We connect its digital world.

Lugia International is a new independent marketing agency led by Mohammed Dalvi, based in Jogeshwari West, Mumbai. We work with founders and businesses that want their online presence to reflect the value they bring in real life.

Maybe you need content that feels consistent, a brand that looks more considered, or a website that makes the next step obvious. We bring the brief, creative direction, project coordination and delivery together, with Mohammed as your single point of contact.

THE WORKING RELATIONSHIP

Good work starts
with good clarity.

A considered experience matters as much as a considered output. Here is how we keep a project grounded from the first conversation.

01

A written scope.

Deliverables, fees, milestones and review rounds are agreed before the work begins, so everyone knows what the project covers.

02

One conversation to keep track of.

Mohammed coordinates your brief, updates and feedback, keeping communication in one place as the project moves forward.

03

Feedback with a purpose.

We review the work against the brief and your audience. Consolidated feedback helps keep decisions useful and the project moving.

04

A practical handover.

You receive the agreed final files and next steps. Where access, assets or third-party costs are needed, these are discussed in the proposal.

05 / GOOD QUESTIONS

A little clarity.

Can we start with just one service?+

Absolutely. Start with a specific need, from a content batch to an SEO review. We’ll agree the deliverables and fee before we begin.

What does a project cost?+

Every brief is different. Share your goals, scope and budget, and Mohammed will put together a project-specific proposal. The proposal will explain what is included, the timeline and any dependencies.

Are you a new agency?+

Yes. Lugia International is a new agency. We’re building our story through thoughtful work, clear proposals and direct communication. For a first engagement, a focused project gives us a clear brief and a practical place to begin.

Who will I speak with?+

Mohammed Dalvi is your point of contact for the brief, project coordination, feedback and handover.

Can you help a local Mumbai business?+

Yes. We’re based in Jogeshwari West, Mumbai. We can scope content, design, local search and website improvements around a local business’s audience and priorities.

How soon can a project start?+

Share your ideal launch date with your brief. We’ll confirm availability, required inputs and a realistic timeline in the proposal before you commit.
